name: agentic-dev-sandbox
title: joaopn/agentic-dev-sandbox
setup: python3 -c 'import os,re; p="docker-compose.yml"; s=open(p).read() if os.path.exists(p) else ""; n=re.sub(r"GITEA__server__ROOT_URL=[^\s\"]+", "GITEA__server__ROOT_URL=http://localhost:${GITEA_PORT:-3000}", s); open(p,"w").write(n) if (s and n != s) else None' && ln -sf "$PWD/README.md" /workspace/README.md
description: An agentic software development sandbox with an integrated Gitea server.
